goal: Add a focused Chinese writing workspace as the third mode of the standalone Dianchi Agent toolbox.

acceptance_criteria.description: The image workspace exposes writing as the third top-level mode, and the standalone server serves the writing workspace at /writing/.
The writing workspace provides an outline, centered document editor, writing assistant controls, word count, copy, and export interactions in Chinese.
The writing workspace does not persist API keys or drafts through localStorage or .env files.
The writing workspace offers local Codex OAuth GPT-5.6 Sol and the five requested AIHUBMIX writing models with exact validated model IDs.
Selected writing models run independently in one comparison request so a failed provider does not discard successful drafts from other models.
The writing UI supports multi-select model comparison, temporary AIHUBMIX credentials, result previews, and explicitly adopting a selected draft alongside the preserved local fixed template.
Model results never automatically replace the current document, and failed model cards offer an isolated refresh retry without discarding other comparison results.
